title: admin login with valid password
description: Test the POST /login endpoint with a valid admin password to verify successful authentication and receipt of a JWT token.

title: submit inquiry with all required fields
description: Test the POST /submit-inquiry endpoint by submitting a new inquiry with all required fields to ensure successful storage in the database.

title: get public inquiries list without authentication
description: Test the GET /get-public-list endpoint without authentication to verify retrieval of public inquiries with masked names.

title: get all inquiries list with admin authentication
description: Test the GET /get-public-list endpoint with valid admin JWT token and getAll=true query to verify retrieval of all inquiries including non-public ones.

title: admin reply to inquiry with valid token
description: Test the POST /admin-reply endpoint by submitting a reply to an inquiry with a valid admin JWT token to verify successful posting or updating of the reply.

title: create msds post with valid admin token
description: Test the POST /create-msds-post endpoint by creating a new MSDS post with valid admin JWT token to verify successful creation of the post.
